label: CRAM + linear latent with its input at G (pseudolikelihood alone, adjoint at the fixed point / damped descent)
test_set: Maze-Hard test (sapientinc/maze-30x30-hard-1k @ 549754de), all 1,000 mazes, scored once per seed
notes: Latent on the open cells: A z = e_G with A = (4 + m) I - Adj (no degree term; one learned mass m = e^mu). Settled by the Jacobi relaxation in log z (all cells at once); pair costs kappa (alpha_ij + alpha_ji), alpha = softmax over self + 4 sides of beta_d + log z_(i+d). Training: pseudolikelihood of the answers alone, Adam lr 0.1 constant, 4,000 updates of 64 mazes; gradient to m by the adjoint relaxation at the fixed point (no differentiation through a solver). Inference: latent settle, then damped descent (step 0.2 from logits 3, fixed-point certificate every 16 steps, at most 2,048 steps). Trained on all 1,000 training mazes. train_gpu_s: the seed-0 cold fit on one H200 (no warm repeats were run); train_cpu_s: not measured. flop_per_puzzle: the value in results/op-counts.json.
